note: Declarative provenance registry for TODO P0-4. Every URL was verified reachable without authentication before being added. Licence findings are recorded verbatim in datasets/licenses/ and summarised in docs/ml/dataset-research.md. Acquisition only — class scope is decided by the P0-5 audit, not here.

provenance.citation: Mohanty, S.P., Hughes, D.P., Salathé, M. (2016). Using deep learning for image-based plant disease detection. Frontiers in Plant Science 7. DOI 10.3389/fpls.2016.01419
provenance.licence_disagreement: Creators state CC BY-SA 3.0 (PlantVillage/PSU and Mohanty's own dataset card); this Mendeley republication asserts CC0 1.0; Zenodo mirror and TFDS catalog say CC BY 4.0. We comply with the strictest reading (attribution + share-alike) and do not redistribute the data. See datasets/licenses/plantvillage.txt.
provenance.selection_note: The 'without augmentation' archive is used deliberately: the pre-augmented variant would leak near-duplicates across train/val splits.

sources.name: PlantDoc (Cropped-PlantDoc classification set) — field-condition test domain

provenance.citation: Singh, D., Jain, N., Jain, P., Kayal, P., Kumawat, S., Batra, N. (2020). PlantDoc: A Dataset for Visual Plant Disease Detection. CoDS-COMAD 2020, 249-253. DOI 10.1145/3371158.3371196
provenance.licence: CC BY 4.0 — full legal code present as LICENSE.txt in the repository; GitHub API reports cc-by-4.0; README concurs. No disagreement found.
provenance.scope_note: This repository hosts the CROPPED classification variant (train/ and test/ class folders), which is what a leaf-disease classifier needs. The 2,598-image figure in the paper refers to the detection dataset with bounding boxes, hosted separately.

files.integrity_note: GitHub codeload responses are chunked and the archive is generated per-request, so no publisher checksum or Content-Length exists. Our own sha256 is recorded in the manifest for local reproducibility.

sources.name: Chilli Leaf Disease Image Dataset (Arifen & Islam 2025)

provenance.citation: Arifen, R., & Islam, S. M. M. (2025). Chilli Leaf Disease Image Dataset for Classification and Early Diagnosis in Agriculture [Dataset]. Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/tm3v4zmh7c.1
provenance.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International) — verified from the Mendeley licence object. Commercial use, redistribution and modification permitted with attribution.
provenance.structure_note: Mixed layout: four disease classes ship as ZIPs at the archive root, two more (Nutrition_Deficiency, Powdery_Mildew) are loose image folders. The whole-dataset archive is used because the per-file API caps at 1000 entries and cannot fully enumerate Nutrition_Deficiency (claimed 1,207 images).

sources.name: Chili Leaf Disease Dataset, Bangladesh (Biswas et al.) — v3

provenance.citation: Biswas, J., Hossain, M. S., & Hasan, M. M. (2026). Chili Leaf Disease Dataset: Annotated Smartphone Images of Anthracnose, Cercospora Leaf Spot, Leaf Curl Disease, and Healthy Leaves in Bangladesh [Dataset]. Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/wzc6r6w5w5.3
provenance.licence: CC BY 4.0 — verified from the Mendeley licence object.
provenance.version_note: v3 (latest) is used and pinned by DOI. It differs materially from v2: 1,515 images vs 1,544, and the healthy class was renamed 'Fresh Leaf' (v3 per-class: Anthracnose 347, Cercospora 367, Leaf Curl 369, Fresh Leaf 432). Earlier planning docs referenced v2's 1,544 figure; the P0-5 audit reconciles the label map.
provenance.geography_note: Bangladesh-collected. Agroclimatically close to eastern India but a proxy, not Indian field data — disclosed in docs/ml/dataset-research.md.

sources.name: SAR-CLD-2024 cotton leaf disease (Bishshash et al. 2024) — OD-1 gated

provenance.citation: Bishshash, P., Nirob, M. A. S., Shikder, M. H., & Sarower, A. (2024). SAR-CLD-2024: A Comprehensive Dataset for Cotton Leaf Disease Detection [Dataset]. Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/b3jy2p6k8w.2
provenance.licence: CC BY 4.0 — verified from the Mendeley licence object.
provenance.structure_note: Archive contains BOTH 'Original Dataset.zip' (~270 MB, 2,137 images) and 'Augmented Dataset.zip' (~1.30 GB, 7,000 images). The augmented images MUST be excluded from validation and test splits, or near-duplicates will inflate metrics — enforced during P0-6 preparation.
provenance.gate_note: Cotton's promotion to SPECIALIZED ML support is decision OD-1, resolved by the P0-5 audit on evidence. Acquisition here does not pre-judge it.

sources.name: Rice Leaf Disease Image Samples, Odisha India (Sethy 2020)

provenance.citation: Sethy, P. K. (2020). Rice Leaf Disease Image Samples [Dataset]. Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/fwcj7stb8r.1
provenance.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International) — verified directly from the Mendeley licence object. Commercial use, redistribution and modification permitted with attribution.
provenance.selection_rationale: Approved substitute for Paddy Doctor (team decision, option C). Chosen because it is real Indian field data — collected at Sambalpur/Bargarh, Odisha — with an unambiguous, verifiable licence. Paddy Doctor offers more classes but sits behind a paid IEEE DataPort subscription AND publishes no licence for its images, which we will not misrepresent.
provenance.scope_note: Published as 5,932 images across 4 classes (bacterial blight, blast, brown spot, tungro). Note there is no 'healthy' class — the P0-5 audit must decide how rice healthy-leaf coverage is handled, since a classifier with no healthy class cannot report a healthy crop. Actual counts come from the audit, not this description.

sources.name: Paddy Doctor (rice) — REJECTED, superseded by rice_odisha
sources.blocked: NOT ACQUIRED — team decision 2026-08-12 (option C) substituted rice_odisha. Two independent blockers, both verified: (1) ACCESS: IEEE DataPort requires a PAID subscription (not a free account); no Zenodo deposit exists; the official site links only to Kaggle and IEEE; the GitHub org holds code only. (2) LICENCE: no authoritative licence for the images is published anywhere — the frequently-cited CC BY-SA 4.0 is the arXiv ARTICLE licence, not the data licence, and the IEEE DataPort record states no licence in any field. Account-free Hugging Face mirrors of the 10,407-image Kaggle subset exist but are unofficial re-uploads that do not launder the upstream ambiguity. Retained here as the decision record; revisit only if the authors publish a licence.
